Package io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.installer

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AddonBalanceMenu
    Admin-only drill-down: the strongest items of one addon, each showing its balance score + tier.
    AddonCatalog
    The source of truth for everything the in-game installer can install: Slimefun core plus every known Slimefun5 addon.
    AddonCatalog.Entry
    A single installable entry.
    AddonDetailMenu
    Screen 2: one entry's status and actions.
    AddonInstaller
    Orchestrates installs/updates/builds: dependency resolution, async download or build, state updates, and player feedback.
    AddonInstallerMenu
    Screen 1 of the installer: a grid of Slimefun core + every addon with a status badge in lore.
    AddonReleaseService
    Talks to the GitHub Releases API for a single entry: finds the latest release's version tag and downloadable jar asset, and downloads jars.
    AddonReleaseService.ReleaseInfo
    The resolved latest release of an entry.
    AddonSourceBuilder
    Builds an entry from a git branch into a jar, using a reusable source cache under plugins/Slimefun/addon-sources/.
    AddonSourceBuilder.Result
    The outcome of a build attempt.
    AddonUpdateJoinListener
    Tells an admin once, on join, about any pending addon/Slimefun updates the installer found at startup.
    BranchSelectMenu
    Screen 3: a paginated list of the repo's branches.
    BranchService
    Lists the branch names of a repository via the GitHub API, for the build-from-branch picker.
    BranchService.Result
    The outcome of a branch fetch: a status plus the branch names (empty unless status is OK).
    EnvironmentDetector
    Detects whether the dev-only "build from a branch" mode is possible: git on PATH and a JDK (a javac executable).
    InstallState
    Persists what the installer has staged: per entry id, the install method, the installed version-or-branch, and whether a restart is pending.
    InstallState.Record
    An immutable record of one staged install.
    InstallTargets
    Resolves where jars and working files go.
    VersionSelectMenu
    A paginated list of all published releases of an addon.
